title: Two sections: Roman front matter, then a restart at 1
concept: Two Section elements in the design map restart page numbering: the left page is numbered ii in lowercase Roman, the right page starts a new section at 1 with a section marker.

annotations.note: Sections come after the idPkg:Spread references and before the stories.
PageStart names the Self of the page the section begins on. ContinueNumbering="false" comes before PageNumberStart: InDesign applies the start number only once it has read the restart.
The numbering style is a typed Properties child, not an attribute. LowerRoman makes page 2 of this section print as ii.
The second section restarts at 1 on the right page. Marker is the text a section marker (<?ACE 19?>) prints on pages of this section.
